summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust, a non-traded Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered private placement of 900,630 common shares for gross proceeds of roughly $9.6 million, priced at September 30, 2026 NAV per share. Class S accounted for 367,043 shares ($3.9 million, including $25,218 of commissions), Class I 528,983 shares ($5.6 million), and Class E 4,604 shares ($50,000). The same filing declared monthly distributions of $0.0416667 gross per share across classes and disclosed NAV per share ($10.5955 to $10.8603). No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine continuous-offering capital raise and distribution notice, not a special situation.
